title: Poo-Pourri Before You Go Toilet Spray
text:
Poo-Pourri Before You Go Toilet Spray. I was on a trip and discussing white elephant gifts with a friend and she told me about the time that everyone was literally "fighting" over this as one of the gifts. I ordered to try. First let me say that I do NOT received free or discounted products to review.
This bottle is relatively small. But then, 4 oz, as it clearly states is NOT very big. Be sure to read and compare with something you have in hand to be sure you understand sizing. I included a pic to help with a realistic view of the size.
The fragrance is mentholy... with a hint of citrus to me - not flowery... but that's just my opinion. I like the smell. The bottle says "essential oils" are used in making it and it is "Made in USA." The bottle notes up to 200 uses. You can be "refill" bottles. But honestly this product is a bit overpriced for me.
The first time I tried it, I used only 4 sprays (the bottle recommends 3-5) AND I forgot to "shake the bottle well" before each use. I found it didn't "tame" much of anything. :(
The second time I tried it I shook the bottle vigorously for a couple of seconds and used 5 sprays. It worked to about 99% in my opinion. Much better than the first try...
I give them 3 stars for the product (mostly because the cost is soooo high) and added a star for a "made in the USA" product. If they dropped the price to about $5-7 per bottle I would be a regular customer and might bump up to 5 stars. A large canister of lysol is less than $5 and works about as well ... in my opinion. And lysol disinfects.. but it is not exactly the same product use set, I know.
The product arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition.
I never hesitate to update my reviews if new information could be helpful, including how many "uses" I actually can achieve.
